summary_md:
**[@yw0nam](https://x.com/yw0nam/status/2115245271907209604)** shares **any-subagent**, a single bash script plus a skill that lets Claude Code dispatch work to other coding-agent CLIs (Codex, opencode, pi, agy) in the background.

Each delegated conversation is named, so a follow-up like "tests fail, fix it" goes back to the same agent with its context intact. No MCP server is required; MIT licensed.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - yw0nam/any-subagent: Run Codex, opencode, pi and other coding-agent CLIs as background subagents from Claude Code. Each conversation has a name, so follow-ups keep their context.

relevance: A minimal, dependency-light pattern for cross-harness subagents with persistent named sessions.
